segments.title: Station Sign-On and Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer; studio technical gremlins immediately surface.

segments.title: Pre-Show Setup and Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Case Blackwell attempts to stabilize a jittery camera feed while acknowledging chat; Crum and Jeff Ripple bicker in background.

segments.title: Abercrombie & Fitch CEO Mike Jeffries Charged with Sex Trafficking
segments.notes: Lead anchor Case Blackwell covers the 16-count federal indictment against former CEO Mike Jeffries, partner Matthew Smith, and recruiter James Jacobson; Jeff Ripple and Crum provide desk commentary on the allegations and Jeffries' appearance.

segments.title: Kendelle Assumes Broadcast Control During Anchor Work Call
segments.notes: Kendelle enters studio, operates Case's triple stream deck via chat vote, triggers assorted sound buttons and a Minecraft Minesweeper tutorial; Case absent on work call.

segments.title: Raid Reception and Sign-Off
segments.notes: Avaly raids the channel; Case returns to thank raiders and close broadcast amid ongoing studio chaos.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open sign-on; camera feed glitches persist throughout opening minutes.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Briefly appears on desk, spars with Jeff Ripple, dismissed by Case to make room for news.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Joins desk to discuss apparent conflict with Crum; provides commentary on Jeffries indictment and standing reporter to Jeffries' left.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Takes over broadcast during Case's work call, runs stream deck mini-game with chat, teaches Minecraft Minesweeper.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Threatened by Kendelle at 33:28; remains in studio walls per lore.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell operates three stream decks simultaneously.
Kendelle has working knowledge of Case's stream deck layout and OBS scenes.
Case Blackwell takes work calls during live broadcast, leaving Kendelle to fill airtime.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers the federal sex trafficking indictment of former Abercrombie & Fitch CEO Mike Jeffries amid persistent camera glitches and desk infighting. Anchor Case Blackwell departs mid-broadcast for a work call, ceding control to Kendelle who orchestrates a chaotic stream-deck mini-game and Minecraft Minesweeper tutorial. The broadcast concludes with a raid from Avaly and Case's return to a still-unruly studio.
